name: Tippling
summary: Highly refined alcohol, almost to the point of purity, infused with the otherwise poisonous Demon's Tongue fungus. Going down with a notable tinge of sulfur, Tippling is a frequent refuge for the over-weary in need of forgetting.
effects: For the Duration, you lose all the benefits of your Skill Ranks (while retaining your Feats.) When this Ends, roll 1d6 Chaos Dice. You shed 1 Corruption unless your roll a 6, in which case you suffer 1 Corruption.

name: Diablerie
summary: Purified concentrate of the Demon's Tongue mushroom. This crimson powder is a violently lethal toxin to nearly anything living and leaves a gruesome trace of its presence in victims.
effects: A wash of rage floods your mind, your eyes turn as red as the lakes of hell, and bloody slaver drips madly from your lips. You become Frenzied for the Duration, always suffering the effects of a rolled 6. At the end of this duration, roll 1d6 Chaos Dice, dying instantly on face 6. If you survive this, you become Unholy, suffer 6 Corruption instantly, and as much as a permenant increase to your Mind. The visual effects on your eyes and saliva are permenant, and if you ever consume this again, you die instantly.

name: Ikthein Tincture
summary: Adaptability is a function of forgetting. The Shard Sea demands Expeditioners be persistent, changeable, and able to continuously evolve. Consequently, they've also learned to Forget. The Ikthein Tincture is one of the most effective means, and allows one to adapt that much faster.
effects: After consuming an Ikthein Tincture, you are instantly rendered Unconscious for 12 Hours. Within this Duration, you experience a dream state that represents your current Abilities, Skills, and Training in a surreal landscape of abstractions and half-logical connections. While in this state, you can Forget.
